offset_convention: CODE segment-body hex offsets ($xxxx), excluding the 4-byte resource header and 4-byte CODE segment header.

-$18e(a5).meaning: Difficulty level: 0 = Novice, 1 = Intermediate, 2 = Advanced, 3 = Black Knight

-$18c(a5).meaning: Room entry selector: tested via tst.w -$18c(a5) in all 14 rooms (0 = primary door/upper entry, nonzero = secondary door/ladder/chute entry)

-$280(a5).meaning: Room-already-visited flag in current session: 0 on first visit, $ff on subsequent visits (guards entry-door closing animation $1f6a(pc) in Rooms 1000 and 4020)

$3fa(a5)_d0.meaning: 16-bit signed PRNG word returned in d0 by $3fa(a5) (CODE 4:$5c68): tested via tst.w d0; bgt.b $5d6 in Room 1020 (CODE 5:$05ba-$05c0) to randomly pick which Dungeon cell holds the key/prop

note_on_spawns_json_null_conditions: In spawns.json, no call had literal 'condition: null'; instead, 188 of the 232 calls had 'required_guards: []' with the disclaimer 'an empty list does not prove an unconditional call' and 'args.other_values: null' (omitting conditional register/table setups that reconverge before jsr). Exhaustive symbolic + 32-state 68000 execution of all 14 CODE 5 room dispatchers resolves all 188 'required_guards: []' calls (listed first under resolved_previously_unguarded_calls) as well as all 44 remaining calls (under all_room_calls_complete).
